title: Name tag
description: The person is the picture: your video or photo fills one side, framed on the face, and a quiet name plate (gold line, thin name, role) rises low on the other side. Nothing is drawn on the person.

props.name: required, 1-3 words
props.role: small gold line above the name
props.note: one quiet line under the name
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 of the picture
props.side: left (default) or right: where the plate goes
props.poster: still shown before the video loads
